fee_review.commission_scope: Published retail exception structure needs account/routing classification before a full fee model; no index-option rate is applied to C13.
fee_review.example_scope: Two standard contract purchases on an otherwise empty fee day: CAT .01 + ORF .03 + OCC .05. Excludes exit, extra commission, exercise and assignment; not a total roundtrip fee or shared-account allocation.
fee_review.exercise_assignment_fee_status: Not independently specified in the captured individual-account fee pages; not assumed zero.
fee_review.rounding: Aggregate each fee type separately per account/day, then round each up to one cent.
fee_review.use: current-account historical counterfactual only if later admitted; not a historical rate timeline or executed fee model

remaining_gate_review: No earnings inventory, candidate historical quote query, return, holdout, option order or forward job. Full cash settlement/exercise model remains uncompleted after execution source failure.

automatic-exercise.review: Long calls may auto exercise into 100 shares and long puts require deliverable shares; discretionary broker liquidation/DNE is not guaranteed modeled execution.

broker-options.review: Partner Broker API documentation describes DNE endpoint. Its capabilities do not establish access through this individual Trading API account.

contracts.review: Current active/inactive catalog with deliverables and ppind field. No decision-time listing or historical penny-program interval supplied.

dne-support.review: September2025 Trading API support guidance requires DNE email before 15:00 ET on expiration day. No email was sent.

fee-schedule.review: September17 2026 fee table: option pass-through fees on page3; daily per-account per-type rounding on page4. Pages3/4 rendered and visually reviewed.

historical-data.review: Free indicative feed modifies OPRA quotes and delays derived trades. History starts February 2024. Does not establish historical executable BBO.

latest-quotes.review: Explicit indicative latest observations are modified quotes. No historical two-leg synchronized BBO sequence.

option-fees.review: Support directs fee questions to brokerage fee schedule. Does not independently specify an exercise/assignment charge.

option-ticks.review: Standard and penny-program increments differ; current ppind and special NOM routing cannot establish historical per-series tick eligibility.

paper-capability.review: Whitelisted current-paper capability projection from one existing SDK GET. Full body discarded, original response hash retained; no live entitlement, cash or margin inference.

regulatory-fees.review: Daily fee-account aggregation; refers to current brokerage schedule for rates. Generic list is not an alternative dated fee schedule.

trading-options.review: Trading API requires whole contracts and level2 for long calls/puts; describes auto exercise and support-mediated DNE. No closing/exercise model is thereby implemented.
